initial_refinement_rule: For each v9 table with a failed held-out node, insert only the arithmetic midpoint of that node's containing equivolume-diameter interval. Do not insert any held-out coordinate and do not change a non-diameter axis.

cross_cell_audit.diameter_scope: Every current diameter leaf wholly contained in each identified v9 parent diameter interval.
cross_cell_audit.other_axis_scope: The Cartesian product of every interval on every other nonsingleton configured axis.
cross_cell_audit.permutation_rule: For each axis interval independently, SHA-256 of seed, candidate config SHA-256, table ID, axis kind, lower float.hex(), and upper float.hex() selects one of the six lexicographic permutations. Sample k uses element k. The hash never changes a fraction and never depends on scattering output.

v9_regression_rule: Recompute and interpolate the three exact failed v9 development nodes against every candidate. Each must satisfy the same 15 percent electromagnetic and 20 percent fall-moment design budgets. These known nodes are never final validation.

recursive_diameter_rule.operation: After a complete audit, bisect only diameter leaves containing one or more failing cross-cell or v9-regression samples, using exact arithmetic midpoints.

non_diameter_fallback.trigger: A complete depth-3 diameter-only audit still fails.
non_diameter_fallback.implicated_intervals: For every failing cross-cell, collect its non-diameter intervals by axis.
non_diameter_fallback.candidate_subsets: Enumerate every nonempty subset of implicated nonsingleton non-diameter axes, at most 15 because the largest table has four such axes. For a chosen axis, insert the arithmetic midpoint of every unique implicated interval on that axis.
non_diameter_fallback.selection: Run the complete audit for every candidate. Select a passing candidate with the smallest total Cartesian grid-point count; ties use lexicographic subset order induced by the configured axis order. Rerun the complete audit once more on the selected bytes.
non_diameter_fallback.failure: If no candidate passes, refined v10 is rejected.
